caption: The video captures an outdoor dirt test area under a clear blue sky, where a pivoting launching rig on the left ends in a large red axe-shaped head. The arm, painted black then yellow, swings downward from an elevated diagonal toward nearly horizontal, carrying the red head toward a small reddish object resting on the ground. As the head reaches ground level, a dense white-blue cloud erupts at that spot and billows upward and outward. The red head becomes hidden and then no longer visible, while several small red fragments appear, flung upward and later drifting toward the right side of the frame. The cloud continues to grow, its lower edge spreading along the dirt to the right, while a flat wooden plank moves low on the ground near the cloud's left edge. Throughout, the tan box and the rig's base remain fixed and the camera stays static.
